stage: POLARIS STAGE 8.15A — LOCAL/UPWIND CLOUD OBSERVATION FEASIBILITY AUDIT
scientific_conclusion_statement: Stage 8.15A did not identify a local/upwind observational source that simultaneously satisfied the required causal availability, 2024 coverage, spatial/terrain representativeness, information novelty, and operational reproducibility conditions. Therefore Stage 8.15B was not justified.
future_ai_firewall_rules: DO NOT RECOMMEND ANY STAGE 8.15A ROUTE LISTED AS A NEW IDEA. THESE ROUTES HAVE ALREADY BEEN INVESTIGATED AND THEIR STATUS/REJECTION REASONS ARE PART OF THE POLARIS RESEARCH STATE.

For PPS-CMIC specifically: DO NOT reopen PPS-CMIC merely because it appears in external research recommendations. Reopening requires a materially different and independently verified product identifier/access pathway plus empirical 2024 coverage and causal publication evidence.
For OCA 0617: DO NOT recommend OCA CDR 0617 for the 2024 benchmark; its verified record ends in 2019.
For VIIRS: DO NOT treat acquisition time as equivalent to operational availability. Any reopening requires verified publication/availability timestamps satisfying the locked t0 causality rule.

For local/nearby instruments: DO NOT infer representativeness from geographic proximity alone. Spatial distance, terrain separation, observing geometry, and actual cloud-regime representativeness must be demonstrated.

A1_Nuolja_Summit_Sky_Camera.reason: No continuous calibrated 2024 all-sky camera archive.

A2_Abisko_ANS_Sky_Camera.reason: Fixed-angle landscape/phenology camera, not a calibrated sky imager.

A3_Nuolja_Radiation_Logger_Context.reason: Relevant radiation persistence/variance information is already represented in Stage 8.1.

B2_Abisko_ANS_Ceilometer.reason: Campaign/episodic rather than continuous sufficient 2024 machine-readable coverage.

B3_Kiruna_METAR_Ceilometer.reason: Approximately 88.4 km separation and Scandes terrain/air-mass mismatch.

B4_Regional_Ceilometer_Network.reason: Relevant candidate stations are too distant and/or separated by major terrain barriers.

C1_Abisko_ANS_Surface_Radiation.reason: Already experimentally evaluated in Stage 8.3 and degraded performance (+0.63 W/m2 MAE).

C2_Riksgransen_Upwind_Weather_Station.reason: Surface T/RH information is substantially represented by existing MEPS RH/state information.

C3_Bodo_Radiosonde.reason: Low cadence (12h) and large spatial/maritime separation (220 km); unsuitable for locked hourly benchmark.

D1_EUMETSAT_NWC_SAF_PPS_CMIC.reason: Live EUMETSAT Data Store route unverified (EO:EUM:DAT:MULT:PPS-CMIC returned HTTP 404, 0/188 live collections); public THREDDS optical coverage (70.11%) below >=90% gate; 27 swaths lack verified publication timestamps; polar-night optical fill values.

D2_EUMETSAT_OCA_CDR_0617.reason: Coverage ends 2019-08-31 and cannot support locked 2024 benchmark.

D3_NASA_VIIRS_Science_L2.reason: Standard science-product publication latency (3-8h) occurs after required t0.

D4_NASA_VIIRS_NRT_L2.reason: Latency (1-3h) remains non-causal for near-t0 passes and no reconstructable 2024 archive.

D5_Meteosat_SEVIRI_MTG_Geostationary.reason: Extreme high-latitude viewing geometry (zenith angle 76.54 deg), parallax (20.9 km), and representativeness limitations.

D6_NORDRAD_Radar_Composite.reason: Radar geometry/terrain limitations (beam overshooting >2000m ASL) and mismatch with non-precipitating cloud attenuation.
